descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_path: Returns the sound sample's file path text.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_28: Returns the integer sample setting at offset 0x28.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_2c: Returns the float sample setting at offset 0x2c.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_30: Returns the float sample setting at offset 0x30.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_4c: Returns the integer sample setting at offset 0x4c.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_24: Returns the float sample setting at offset 0x24.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_channels: Returns how many stream channels (0, 1 or 2) the sample opened.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_1c: Returns the integer sample setting at offset 0x1c.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_3c: Returns the float sample setting at offset 0x3c.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_38: Returns the float sample setting at offset 0x38.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_50: Returns the integer sample setting at offset 0x50.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_54: Returns the integer sample setting at offset 0x54.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_stream: Returns the stream handle for the given channel index of a sample.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_list_get: Returns the global list that owns stream player objects.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_unlink: Removes a stream player from its global list and decrements the list count.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_create: Allocates and constructs a stream player and registers it in the global list.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_type_get: Returns the type descriptor used to identify stream cue objects.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_release: Drops one reference to a stream cue; when none remain it unlinks and destroys it. Returns the remaining count.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_retain: Adds one reference to a stream cue and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_stream_cue_cast: Checks or converts an object against the stream cue type descriptor via the generic type-cast helper.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_type_get: Returns the type descriptor used to identify stream player objects.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_release: Drops one reference to a stream player; when none remain it unlinks and destroys it. Returns the remaining count.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_retain: Adds one reference to a stream player and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_cast: Checks or converts an object against the stream player type descriptor via the generic type-cast helper.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_construct_801e292c: Stream player constructor: sets up the node, member and cue vector, clears six channels and publishes itself as current.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_destroy_801e29e8: Stream player destructor: deletes its channels, clears the current instance, releases its output and frees memory.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_open: Opens the stream player: initialises its member and creates six numbered stream channels.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_close: Stops and deletes all six stream channels, then closes the player's member object.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_stop_all: Stops every existing stream channel of the player.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_pause_category: Appears to pause every active queued cue whose sample matches a category, along with the channel playing it.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_resume_category: Appears to resume every queued cue whose sample matches a category, along with the channel playing it.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_kind: Returns 2, likely the interface kind identifier for the stream player.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_stub_801e2e38: Stub stream player method that always returns 0.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_create_cue: Creates a new cue with the next id, attaches a sample and stores a referenced pointer in the caller's slot.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_not_implemented_801e2f: Returns the 'not implemented' result code; a stub stream player method.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_forget_sample: When a streamed sample goes away, detaches it from every cue using it and stops the matching channel.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_set_volume: Stores the stream player's volume and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_stream_player_not_implemented_801e32: Returns the 'not implemented' result code; a stub stream player method.
